name: ASCII
description: The picture turns into text-mode characters, denser where it is brighter, the characters scramble into those of the second clip, then resolve back into it. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: cell_size
params.description: Height of a character, in frame heights

params.name: colored
params.description: Color the characters with the picture (otherwise, with the ink color)

params.name: ink
params.description: Color of the characters when they are not colored with the picture
